historical_context: The original Main statement explicitly bundled nowhere analyticity and the target renorming obstruction; no-lift and nowhere C^omega already followed from its proved lift criterion. Automated review requested all these conclusions in the primary declaration. This new wrapper closes that statement-packaging finding without replacing or altering the existing construction.

checks.result: The proof destructures exists_nowhereAnalytic_banach_counterexample once and reuses exactly E,F,gE,gF,nE,nF,cE,cF and hF. All three conclusions share those spaces and structures. E′ is literally E.

K:Type u is fixed by the caller; E,F:Type u; the finite form-index type is arbitrary ι:Type v. The theorem has the same universe parameters as Main. Its only scalar hypotheses are NontriviallyNormedField K, CharP K p, p.Prime and p≤k. CompleteSpace K, spherical completeness, a special Laurent-field presentation and any chosen lift are absent from the hypotheses.

Actual CompleteSpace E and CompleteSpace F instances are existential outputs. The same F satisfies ¬HasEquivalentUltrametricNorm K F, whose definition uses a genuine ultrametric K-seminorm with positive two-sided norm-comparison constants.

checks.item: All finite indices and all points
checks.result: The E,F witnesses are chosen before ∀ι[Fintypeι],cardι=k. For each such ι, no bounded lift and both pointwise failures hold; the latter quantify every f₀:E→L[K]E, not only zero.

checks.item: Actual precomposition in the no-lift clause
checks.result: Round24Transfer.HasBoundedLift unfolds to existence of an actual continuous card(ι)-multilinear P with diagonal Round24Transfer.Q. Q is a noncomputable abbreviation for ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM (LiftCriterion.lean lines193–194 and257–260). The cardinality premise makes the degree exactly k; no proxy predicate is used.

checks.item: Actual precomposition in the two pointwise clauses
checks.result: Both AnalyticAt and ContDiffAt K ω use the literal same function f↦ContinuousAlternatingMap.compContinuousLinearMapCLM f between the actual continuous alternating-map operator spaces. ω is the ContDiff analytic regularity exponent, not finite smoothness or the ∞ exponent.

A hypothetical actual P with that diagonal gives CPolynomialAt and hence AnalyticAt at zero via Round24Transfer.cpolynomialAt_of_lift, contradicting the original nowhere-analytic conclusion for the same ι and witnesses.

For the same f₀, a hypothetical ContDiffAt K ω gives AnalyticAt via the genuine Mathlib ContDiffAt.analyticAt theorem; the previously proved nowhere-analytic conclusion contradicts it. No added completeness premise on K is used.
